annotations.title: Robot training pay by kind of work

description: What robot training work pays per hour today, by kind of work: the median and the typical range (25th to 75th percentile) of the rates open roles advertise, with how many rates and employers each figure comes from. A rate is shown only when at least three employers advertise it. Name a kind of work to have its figure first.

kind.description: Kind of work to answer first, e.g. 'teleoperation'. The other kinds follow.
